```sql
SELECT DISTINCT p.productname
FROM customers AS c

JOIN orderdetails AS od ON od.ordernumber = o.ordernumber
JOIN products AS p ON p.productcode = od.productcode
WHERE c.customername = 'Herkku Gifts';
```

old_chain_of_thoughts:
Final SQL:
```sql
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_payments
FROM payments AS p
JOIN customers AS c ON p.customernumber = c.customernumber
WHERE c.customername = 'Atelier graphique';
```
